2610.11294.title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
2610.11294.paper_summary: Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. Its payoff is cross-domain generalization: on multiple unseen domains it attains end-to-end zero-shot speedup---to our knowledge the first for presolve action sequences---varying by domain and not explained by corpus richness, the strongest domain reaching the largest speedup once racing is added. Deployment uses sequence racing, in which candidate sequences run concurrently and the winner is kept, enabled by an execution-and-observation facility, added by modifying the SCIP source, that injects sequences along the native path and records which actions actually execute and in which round.
2610.11294.paper_summary_zh: 預處理對混合整數規劃（MIP）的性能有著強烈的影響，然而基於學習的方法僅能優化參數配置，無法表達行動之間的非交換性時間依賴性，其默認順序在大多數領域中幾乎是唯一的，但在功能上是必要的：人為地打亂相同序列的順序會使解決時間分佈的尾部膨脹幾倍。我們將預處理規劃重新表述為在統一的原子行動空間上進行自回歸序列生成，將決策對象移至行動序列；我們稱這個框架為ORDO——操作級別的回合感知動態排序，用於MIP預處理。它的收益是跨領域的泛化：在多個未見過的領域上，它實現了端到端的零樣本加速——據我們所知，這是預處理行動序列的首次——根據領域的不同而變化，並且無法用語料庫的豐富性解釋，最強的領域在加入競賽後達到了最大的加速。部署使用序列競賽，其中候選序列同時運行，並保留獲勝者，這是通過修改SCIP源代碼添加的執行和觀察設施來實現的，該設施沿著原生路徑注入序列並記錄哪些行動實際執行以及在第幾回合。
2610.11294.author: Zehuan Chen et.al.
